scope: Theorem 6.1 (Finite-data Frobenius incompatibility) of the manuscript “Numerical Semiampleness of Nef Adjoint Divisors” (preprints/Numerical-Semiampleness-of-Nef-Adjoint-Divisors-October-3-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 036 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 b3f337e5dc5b1eda), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 20-21. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let W be a smooth connected projective complex variety of dimension n ≥ 2. Let D, H be rational Cartier divisors, with H ample, let S be an integral Cartier divisor, and fix an integer q > 0 and real numbers r > 1, ϵ > 0. Suppose (6.1) Hn ≤ (2ϵ)n , KW Hn−1 ≤ 2Hn /r, (2D + qS)Hn−1 ≤ 4Hn , (14ϵ)n < 1 4, 80ϵ < 3 4. Assume that the following fixed data exist. (i) A smooth integral complete-intersection flag from W to a curve C, whose successive divisor classes are hi = liH for fixed positive integers li for which liH is Cartier, with µmin(Ω1 W |C) ≥ 0. (ii) On the projective bundle Z = P OW (S)1 ⊕ OW (S)2  −→ W × W, ξ = c1(OZ(1)), M = D1 + D2 + qξ, use the convention that the direct image of OZ(aξ) is the a-th symmetric power of the displayed sum for a ≥ 0; subscripts indicate pullback from the corresponding factor of W × W. The two axes are the sections defined by the two summands. A smooth point z∗ in their complement and finitely many sections of k0M, for some integer k0 > 0 with k0D Cartier, generate jets through order (2n + 2)k0 at z∗. NUMERICAL SEMIAMPLENESS OF NEF ADJOINT DIVISORS 21 (iii) A point x ∈ W, its blowup πx : c W → W with exceptional divisor J, and a curve class γ = f∗(A1 · · · An−1), where f : V → c W is one fixed birational morphism, V is smooth integral projective, and the Ai are ample integral Cartier divisors, such that J · γ > 0 and (6.2) π∗ x(D + KW /2 + λS) · γ ≤ 40ϵJ · γ (0 ≤ λ ≤ q). It suffices to check the two endpoints in this affine inequality. These data cannot coexist.
